safe-file-update.title: Preserve the old report until the new result is ready
safe-file-update.summary: Validation and temporary-file writes happen before replacement. Failure before a successful replacement leaves the destination unchanged in this single-writer local example.

nodes.label: Validate all input
nodes.description: Read and validate every CSV row before selecting a status or opening any output file.

nodes.label: Calculate and serialize
nodes.description: Create the selected count and total as a complete JSON string.

nodes.label: Write a temporary file
nodes.description: Create it beside the destination, write the result and close it.

nodes.label: Replace the destination
nodes.description: os.replace changes the destination after the temporary write succeeds.

nodes.label: Keep the old destination
nodes.description: A validation failure leaves the destination untouched. A replacement exception also triggers temporary-file cleanup.

steps.title: Validate before output
steps.explanation: No destination is opened while the CSV is still being checked.

steps.title: Prepare a complete file
steps.explanation: Calculation and temporary-file writing complete before the destination changes.

steps.title: Replace or preserve
steps.explanation: A successful replacement installs the new report. A failure preserves the old destination and cleans the temporary file; power-loss durability remains outside this lab.
